page_title: SOU 1-2 ARS | Southampton v Arsenal 25/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's it for today, Darren Bond has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' Arsenal keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
90+4' The game is interrupted now, Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.

90' 1 - 2 Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) scores an incredible goal! He receives a pass, makes some space for himself and unleashes a long-range thunderbolt of a shot past the goalkeeper into the bottom right corner.
86' Here comes a substitution. Joachim Kayi Sanda (Southampton) is brought on as a substitute for Lesley Ugochukwu.
85' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
83' Some neat passing and movement from Arsenal as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
79' Simon Rusk prepares a substitution. Jay Robinson is replaced by William Smallbone (Southampton).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cameron Archer is coming onto the pitch as Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
75' That will be all from Ethan Nwaneri who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Martin Odegaard (Arsenal).
74' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Arsenal comes to nothing.
73' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball goes out of play. Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kai Havertz (Arsenal) comes onto the pitch for Gabriel Martinelli.
70' Albert Stuivenberg decides to make a substitution. Oleksandr Zinchenko will be replaced by Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal).
70' Substitution. Ross Stewart did his best and is replaced by Paul Onuachu (Southampton).
68' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
67' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
67' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

66' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. It will be a corner kick for Arsenal.
66' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
65' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 2:6.
63' Albert Stuivenberg has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) replacing Kieran Tierney.
63' The substitution is prepared. Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Raheem Sterling.
59' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
59' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) takes it short.
58' Declan Rice (Arsenal) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Arsenal are going to take it.
56' 1 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Ross Stewart (Southampton) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight into the top right corner. He makes it 1:1.
56' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) takes the corner.

56' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Southampton.
55' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) unleashes a powerful shot from the free kick but it only hits the defensive wall.

53' What a sweet touch by Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) as he collects a pass. From near the edge of the box he produces a shot which goes towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to thwart him!
50' Southampton fail to score from a corner as David Raya (Arsenal) leaps to collect the ball.
49' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jay Robinson (Southampton). Southampton have been awarded a corner kick.
48' A spell of possession for Arsenal in an attempt to control the game.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Darren Bond blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' A rebound spins to Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the left post.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Ben White laid the ball off to Kieran Tierney (Arsenal), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
42' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Arsenal.
42' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders. Arsenal force their opponents to concede a corner.
41' Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) takes the corner with a short pass.

41' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Aaron Ramsdale pulls off a brilliant save. Arsenal earn a corner.
40' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Aaron Ramsdale, who smothers the ball.
38' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
35' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) serves up a nice cross, but David Raya punches the ball away.
33' Some patient build-up play from Arsenal as they look to unlock the defence.
30' Kieran Tierney (Arsenal) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
28' Jay Robinson (Southampton) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
27' Thomas Partey (Arsenal) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Aaron Ramsdale was alert and made a comfortable save.
27' Raheem Sterling (Arsenal) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
26' Corner kicks – 3:3.
23' Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

22' Kieran Tierney (Arsenal) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Arsenal will take a corner kick.
21' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Southampton.
20' A rebound sits up nicely for Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton), whose shot from distance is blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Southampton will have an opportunity.
20' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Mateus Fernandes (Southampton). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
19' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Mateus Fernandes (Southampton), but one of the defenders gets it clear. The referee signals a corner kick to Southampton.
19' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Southampton get a corner.
18' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

18' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick.
17' Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
16' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) tackles a bit over-zealously and Darren Bond blows for a foul. Arsenal win a free kick.
14' Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
14' Raheem Sterling (Arsenal) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Now Arsenal have a corner.
10' Southampton hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
7' That was close by Raheem Sterling (Arsenal)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
6' Nathan Wood (Southampton) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Darren Bond blows his whistle for a foul.
4' A cross is slung in towards the penalty spot and Mikel Merino (Arsenal) creates space for himself but sends his header inches over the bar.
2' Aaron Ramsdale makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) after a cross from the side.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Southampton will have the kick-off.
Darren Bond will supervise the game today.
